crustal and upper mantle rocks were juxtaposed in the Kimi complex, but had distinct ascent paths, and that this tectonic mixture was formed by a subduction channel.
the UHP crustal rocks were not derived from the subducted oceanic slab, but rather from the lower crust of the overriding plate.
